sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园里发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到斩首，体内的血液也被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来凶手费尽心机来掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达（Ada）。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列节目，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: It's cold and rainy in Los Angeles County on the morning of Wednesday, January 26, 2005.
sentences.zh: 2005年1月26日星期三清晨，洛杉矶县天气寒冷且下着雨。

sentences.en: Shortly before 6am, Jenny Doe pulled into the deserted car park of the Costco Retail Warehouse in Glendale, a suburb 10 miles north of downtown LA.
sentences.zh: 清晨6点前不久，珍妮·多伊（Jenny Doe）将车开进了位于洛杉矶市中心以北10英里郊区格伦代尔的好市多零售仓库荒凉的停车场。

sentences.en: While dark, quiet, and dreary outside, the interior of the Costco was bright and bustling, with employees preparing for the day ahead.
sentences.zh: 外面虽然黑暗、安静且阴沉，但好市多内部却灯火通明、人头攒动，员工们正在为新的一天做准备。

sentences.en: Jenny began work at the loading dock.
sentences.zh: 珍妮开始在装卸货区工作。

sentences.en: A few minutes into her shift, a thunderous roar blasted through the building, causing the entire warehouse to shake.
sentences.zh: 在她开始上班几分钟后，一声震耳欲聋的巨响穿透了整栋建筑，导致整个仓库都在震动。

sentences.en: Within moments, the area fell eerily silent.
sentences.zh: 片刻之内，该地区陷入了一片诡异的寂静。

sentences.en: Jenny stopped what she was doing and looked anxiously at those around her.
sentences.zh: 珍妮停下手头的工作，焦急地看着周围的人。

sentences.en: Once their shock had worn off, the workers rushed out to investigate the source of the frightening noise.
sentences.zh: 震惊过去后，工人们冲出去调查这可怕噪音的来源。

sentences.en: Earlier that morning, engineer Bruce Gray boarded Metrolink 100, a blue and white double-decker train headed for downtown LA.
sentences.zh: 那天清晨早些时候，工程师布鲁斯·格雷（Bruce Gray）登上了 Metrolink 100 次列车，这是一列开往洛杉矶市中心的蓝白相间双层列车。

sentences.en: Over 100 commuters were spread out behind him on the train's upper and lower compartments.
sentences.zh: 列车的前后上下车厢里分散着100多名通勤乘客。

sentences.en: Bruce entered the front carriage and took his position behind the controls.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯进入前车厢，在控制台后就位。

sentences.en: Metrolink 100 reached a speed of around 80 miles per hour as it hurtled from station to station.
sentences.zh: Metrolink 100 次列车以每小时约80英里的速度在各个车站之间飞驰。

sentences.en: Soon, the train was on the outskirts of the city, heading south towards Glendale.
sentences.zh: 很快，列车驶入城市边缘，向南朝格伦代尔驶去。

sentences.en: As its headlights pierced the pre-dawn darkness, Bruce Gray noticed something glint up ahead.
sentences.zh: 当车头灯刺破黎明前的黑暗时，布鲁斯·格雷发现前方有什么东西在闪烁。

sentences.en: Parked on the rails was a green Jeep Cherokee SUV.
sentences.zh: 铁轨上停着一辆绿色的吉普切诺基 SUV。

sentences.en: It was sitting a little further up from the Chevy Chase Drive crossing.
sentences.zh: 它停在稍过雪佛龙蔡斯大道（Chevy Chase Drive）交叉口的地方。

sentences.en: Its headlights were off.
sentences.zh: 它的车头灯是关着的。

sentences.en: Bruce couldn't see anyone near it.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯看不到附近有任何人。

sentences.en: He slammed on the emergency brakes and shut off the throttle.
sentences.zh: 他猛踩紧急制动器并切断了油门。

sentences.en: But it was too late.
sentences.zh: 但为时已晚。

sentences.en: Knowing the train had no chance of stopping in time, Bruce ran through the carriage behind him, yelling at passengers to hold on.
sentences.zh: 明知列车不可能及时停下，布鲁斯穿过身后的车厢，大喊让乘客抓紧。

sentences.en: Seconds later, the train collided with the Jeep at approximately 63 miles per hour.
sentences.zh: 几秒钟后，列车以大约每小时63英里的速度撞上了吉普车。

sentences.en: The Jeep overturned and embedded under the front of the first carriage.
sentences.zh: 吉普车翻倒并嵌入第一节车厢的前部下方。

sentences.en: The grinding metal on metal produced hot sparks that triggered a blaze at the collision point.
sentences.zh: 金属与金属的剧烈摩擦产生了炽热的火花，在撞击点引发了一场火灾。

sentences.en: It spread quickly through the first undercarriage.
sentences.zh: 火势迅速蔓延到第一个底盘。

sentences.en: The screams of commuters echoed down the remaining carriages, accompanied by the loud crashing noises caused by the fiery impact.
sentences.zh: 通勤者的尖叫声在其余车厢中回荡，伴随着熊熊烈火撞击产生的巨大轰鸣声。

sentences.en: Because of the Jeep's comparative size, the collision did little to slow the train.
sentences.zh: 由于吉普车的相对体型较小，这次碰撞对减慢列车速度几乎没有起作用。

sentences.en: It continued along for 250 yards to where the track split in two.
sentences.zh: 列车继续前行了250码，到达轨道一分为二的地方。

sentences.en: The front part of the first passenger carriage exited and travelled along the sidetrack, while its rear and the remaining carriages continued along the mainline.
sentences.zh: 第一节乘客车厢的前部驶出并沿着侧线行驶，而其后部和其余车厢继续沿着主线行驶。

sentences.en: The lights inside the train flickered out.
sentences.zh: 列车内的灯光闪烁熄灭。

sentences.en: Commuters fell silent.
sentences.zh: 通勤者安静了下来。

sentences.en: All they could hear was the screeching of the undercarriage as it dragged across gravel.
sentences.zh: 他们能听到的只有底盘在碎石上拖拽的刺耳声音。

sentences.en: They braced themselves, in nervous anticipation.
sentences.zh: 他们做好了准备，怀着紧张的期待。

sentences.en: It was common for trains to be parked on the sidetrack when not in use.
sentences.zh: 火车不使用时停在侧线上是很常见的。

sentences.en: On this occasion, a freight train was dormant on the sidetrack and had been for several days.
sentences.zh: 这一次，一辆货运列车静止停在侧线上，并且已经停了好几天。

sentences.en: It contained construction materials used to repair a portion of the track further north that had been damaged from a recent mudslide.
sentences.zh: 它装有建筑材料，用于修复最近泥石流受损的更北边的一部分轨道。

sentences.en: Now split between both the mainline and sidetrack, the front passenger carriage of MetroLink 100 collided with the stationary freight train at about 47 miles per hour.
sentences.zh: 如今一分为二，分别在主线和侧线上行驶的 MetroLink 100 次列车前客运车厢以大约每小时47英里的速度撞上了静止的货运列车。

sentences.en: Half the carriage was crushed on impact.
sentences.zh: 车厢的一半在撞击中被压扁。

sentences.en: Passengers inside were violently thrown from their seats, with some landing on the tracks outside.
sentences.zh: 车内的乘客被猛烈地抛出座位，一些人落在了外面的铁轨上。

sentences.en: Smoke filled the air as the train jackknifed across the tracks and derailed, spilling debris everywhere.
sentences.zh: 当列车在轨道上呈折叠状并脱轨、碎片到处飞溅时，浓烟弥漫了空气。

sentences.en: Travelling in the opposite direction was another double-decker passenger train.
sentences.zh: 朝着相反方向行驶的是另一列双层客运列车。

sentences.en: Engineer Thomas Ormiston was operating MetroLink 901, heading north from downtown LA.
sentences.zh: 工程师托马斯·奥米斯顿（Thomas Ormiston）正在驾驶 MetroLink 901 次列车，从洛杉矶市中心向北行驶。

sentences.en: Thomas was on schedule, having just departed Glendale Station.
sentences.zh: 托马斯正按时间表行驶，刚刚离开格伦代尔车站。

sentences.en: Within moments, his train sped into the crash site ahead.
sentences.zh: 片刻之内，他的列车加速冲进前方的事故现场。

sentences.en: The first two passenger carriages of the 901 narrowly cleared the accident between MetroLink 100 and the freight train.
sentences.zh: 901 次列车的前两节客运车厢险险避开了 MetroLink 100 与货运列车之间的事故。

sentences.en: Had it not been for the jackknife effect caused by the collision, MetroLink 901 would have passed through the area unscathed.
sentences.zh: 要不是撞击造成的折叠效应，MetroLink 901 本可以安然无恙地穿过该地区。

sentences.en: However, MetroLink 100 raked down the entire side of the final passenger carriage of the 901, completely caving it in on one side.
sentences.zh: 然而，MetroLink 100 刮擦了 901 最后一节客运车厢的整个侧面，将其一面完全凹陷进去。

sentences.en: As the 901 was travelling at approximately 50 miles per hour, the impact caused all three of its passenger carriages to derail and topple over.
sentences.zh: 由于 901 当时正以大约每小时50英里的速度行驶，撞击导致其所有三节客运车厢脱轨并倾覆。

sentences.en: An overhead signal tower also sustained damage, falling and crashing onto one of the carriages.
sentences.zh: 一个高架信号塔也受到损坏，倒塌并砸在一节车厢上。

sentences.en: Debris from the three-train wreck spilled over into the parking lot of the nearby Costco.
sentences.zh: 三列火车残骸的碎片散落到附近好市多的停车场里。

sentences.en: Employees emerged from the building and rushed to the scene armed with fire extinguishers.
sentences.zh: 员工们从大楼里跑出来，手持灭火器冲向现场。

sentences.en: They desperately battled the flames engulfing the front carriage of MetroLink 100, which were reaching 20 feet high.
sentences.zh: 他们拼命扑灭吞没 MetroLink 100 前车厢的大火，火势高达20英尺。

sentences.en: A Costco employee retrieved a forklift from the warehouse to try to dislodge some of the wreckage to reach those trapped inside.
sentences.zh: 一名好市多员工从仓库取来一辆叉车，试图移开部分残骸以营救被困在里面的人。

sentences.en: Others risked their own lives by directly pulling people from the wreck, which was so damaged it hardly resembled a carriage.
sentences.zh: 其他人则直接将人从残骸中拉出来，冒着生命危险，那残骸损毁严重，已经完全不像一节车厢了。

sentences.en: When leaking diesel fuel soaked their clothes, they were forced to ease back or risk catching fire.
sentences.zh: 当泄漏的柴油浸湿他们的衣服时，他们被迫退后，否则有着火的危险。

sentences.en: Yet, they managed to pull out one final victim before retreating, a man covered in blood and soot.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们在撤退前设法救出了最后一名受害者，那是一个浑身是血和烟灰的男人。

sentences.en: All of his limbs appeared to be broken and his face was charred black.
sentences.zh: 他的四肢似乎都骨折了，脸也被烧得焦黑。

sentences.en: As he was lifted out, the injured man profusely thanked his rescuers.
sentences.zh: 当被抬出来时，受伤的男子向他的救命恩人连声道谢。

sentences.en: He asked them to pray for him before closing his eyes.
sentences.zh: 他闭上眼睛前，请求他们为他祈祷。

sentences.en: Minutes later, he passed away.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，他去世了。

sentences.en: He was one of 11 fatalities.
sentences.zh: 他是11名遇难者之一。

sentences.en: Eight people had died on MetroLink 100.
sentences.zh: 8人在 MetroLink 100 上丧生。

sentences.en: The remainder were on board MetroLink 901.
sentences.zh: 其余人员在 MetroLink 901 上。

sentences.en: At 6.03am, three short beeps came over the radio of the LAPD's Northeast Division.
sentences.zh: 早晨6点03分，洛杉矶警察局（LAPD）东北分局的无线电中传出三声短促的蜂鸣声。

sentences.en: An announcement followed, explaining that there had been a train derailment at Glendale.
sentences.zh: 随后发布了一则广播，解释说格伦代尔发生了一起火车脱轨事故。

sentences.en: Officers raced to the location.
sentences.zh: 警官们赶往现场。

sentences.en: They were confronted by a thick cloud of smoke that reeked of diesel fuel.
sentences.zh: 呈现在他们眼前的是一股散发着柴油味的浓烟。

sentences.en: It shadowed a chaotic scene.
sentences.zh: 它笼罩着混乱的场景。

sentences.en: A dazed and frantic crowd had gathered in the parking lot of the nearby Costco.
sentences.zh: 一群惊魂未定、情绪狂乱的人聚集在附近好市多的停车场里。

sentences.en: Almost 200 people bore injuries.
sentences.zh: 近200人受伤。

sentences.en: Those in the worst condition were being wheeled around in store carts.
sentences.zh: 状况最严重的人被用商店手推车推着转移。

sentences.en: Others were shaken, but able to walk.
sentences.zh: 其他人则受到惊吓，但能够行走。

sentences.en: The adjacent train tracks were a mess of twisted and burning metal.
sentences.zh: 毗邻的铁轨是一片扭曲、燃烧的金属乱麻。

sentences.en: Firefighters extinguished the accompanying blaze, allowing responders to retrieve the remaining passengers scattered throughout the crash site.
sentences.zh: 消防员扑灭了大火，救援人员得以搜救散落在事故现场各处的其余乘客。

sentences.en: They had sustained fractured bones, head injuries, lacerations, and in some cases, impalement from train debris.
sentences.zh: 他们骨折、头部受伤、裂伤，在某些情况下被火车碎片刺穿。

sentences.en: The cause of the crash, the Jeep Cherokee SUV, was near obliterated.
sentences.zh: 事故的罪魁祸首——吉普切诺基 SUV，几乎被彻底摧毁。

sentences.en: Pieces of the vehicle were scattered over 300 yards.
sentences.zh: 车辆碎片散落在300多码的范围内。

sentences.en: What was left of the Jeep's chassis was still lodged upside down under the burnt remains of MetroLink 100's front passenger carriage.
sentences.zh: 吉普车的底盘残骸仍然倒扣在烧焦的 MetroLink 100 前客运车厢残骸下方。

sentences.en: Even though the vehicle's fuel tank was warped by heat, it remained intact.
sentences.zh: 尽管车辆油箱因高温而变形，但它仍然完好无损。

sentences.en: It contained almost 12 gallons of gasoline, meaning it was almost full.
sentences.zh: 里面装着将近12加仑的汽油，这意味着它几乎是满的。

sentences.en: Investigators walked along the track examining the remains of the Jeep.
sentences.zh: 调查人员沿着铁轨检查吉普车的残骸。

sentences.en: They located two plastic one-gallon water bottles that had been in the vehicle, along with a headrest, upholstery from the passenger side door and back seat,
sentences.zh: 他们在车里找到了两个一加仑的塑料水瓶，还有一个头枕、副驾驶侧车门和后座的内饰，

sentences.en: weather stripping from around the rear window, and two pieces of moulding from the roof.
sentences.zh: 后窗周围的防风雨条，以及两块车顶饰条。

sentences.en: Even though the Jeep's fuel tank was intact, all of these items tested positive for gasoline.
sentences.zh: 尽管吉普车的油箱完好无损，但所有这些物品的汽油检测结果均呈阳性。

sentences.en: They also located the tailgate with the licence plate attached.
sentences.zh: 他们还找到了带有车牌的后挡板。

sentences.en: A witness emerged who had seen the Jeep moments prior to the crash.
sentences.zh: 一名目击者站了出来，他在撞车前不久看到了那辆吉普车。

sentences.en: It was driving along Chevy Chase Drive before pulling off to continue along the side road parallel to the railway lines.
sentences.zh: 它沿着雪佛龙蔡斯大道行驶，然后拐弯继续沿着与铁路线平行的侧路行驶。

sentences.en: It was put in park, and a male driver got out.
sentences.zh: 它挂入停车挡，一名男司机走了出来。

sentences.en: He then poured liquid from a large jug all over the exterior of the vehicle, starting on the roof and then moving to the hood and rear.
sentences.zh: 然后他将一个大壶里的液体倒在汽车的整个外表上，从车顶开始，然后移至引擎盖和后部。

sentences.en: Once the bottle was empty, the man got back into the Jeep and continued driving down the side road until he found an entry point onto the train line.
sentences.zh: 瓶子空了之后，这名男子重新上车，沿着侧路继续开，直到找到一个通往铁路线的入口点。

sentences.en: He then parked the vehicle on the tracks.
sentences.zh: 然后他把车停在铁轨上。

sentences.en: And waited.
sentences.zh: 然后等待。

sentences.en: 25-year-old Juan Manuel Alvarez had a rough start in life.
sentences.zh: 25岁的胡安·曼努埃尔·阿尔瓦雷斯（Juan Manuel Alvarez）的人生开局艰难。
zh_words: 胡安·曼努埃尔·阿尔瓦雷斯

sentences.en: Born in 1979, Juan grew up in Mexicali, a city along the US-Mexico border.
sentences.zh: 胡安出生于1979年，在美墨边境城市墨西卡利长大。

sentences.en: He was beaten and abused by his alcoholic and drug-dealing father, who had been a professional boxer.
sentences.zh: 他遭到身为职业拳击手的酗酒兼贩毒父亲的殴打和虐待。

sentences.en: After one particularly brutal attack, Juan's father tied him to a table overnight.
sentences.zh: 在一次特别残酷的袭击后，胡安的父亲将他绑在桌子上过夜。

sentences.en: On another occasion, 8-year-old Juan was pulled from his home by his older sister, Cynthia.
sentences.zh: 还有一次，8岁的胡安被姐姐辛西亚（Cynthia）从家里拉出来。

sentences.en: Once outside, Cynthia watched through a window as her father beat their mother so severely that blood soaked her face.
sentences.zh: 到了外面，辛西亚透过窗户看着父亲毒打他们的母亲，打得母亲满脸是血。

sentences.en: They were both mouthing words at Cynthia, but she couldn't make out what they were saying.
sentences.zh: 他们俩都在对辛西亚动着嘴型，但她听不清他们在说什么。

sentences.en: Turning around, Cynthia saw Juan trying to hang himself.
sentences.zh: 转过身去，辛西亚看到胡安正试图上吊自杀。

sentences.en: Their father came outside and rescued him.
sentences.zh: 他们的父亲走了出来救了他。

sentences.en: A short while after, Juan tried to take his own life again, this time by jumping in front of a moving bus.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，胡安再次试图结束自己的生命，这次是跳到一辆行驶的公交车前面。

sentences.en: His grandmother pulled him to safety just in time.
sentences.zh: 他的祖母及时把他拉到了安全地带。

sentences.en: As a child, Juan claimed he was molested by an uncle.
sentences.zh: 胡安声称自己小时候遭到过一个叔叔的猥亵。

sentences.en: Around this time, he started having delusions.
sentences.zh: 大约在这个时候，他开始产生妄想。

sentences.en: Juan featured an evil spirit that entered Juan's room at night, crawled into his bed, and slept next to him.
sentences.zh: 胡安的脑海里有一个恶灵，它在夜里进入胡安的房间，爬上他的床，睡在他旁边。

sentences.en: When Juan spoke of this nightmare, he would zone out and stare into nothingness.
sentences.zh: 当胡安谈起这场噩梦时，他会神情恍惚，凝视着虚空。

sentences.en: At age 12, Juan moved to LA.
sentences.zh: 12岁时，胡安搬到了洛杉矶。

sentences.en: While cannabis helped him cope with his troubled past, it took harder drugs to keep the delusions at bay.
sentences.zh: 虽然大麻帮助他应对充满麻烦的过去，但需要更强烈的毒品才能抑制住这些妄想。

sentences.en: Juan developed a cocaine and methamphetamine addiction, but they only fuelled his disassociation from reality.
sentences.zh: 胡安对可卡因和甲基苯丙胺产生了瘾癖，但这只会加剧他与现实的脱节。

sentences.en: He spoke of hearing voices and seeing people who weren't there.
sentences.zh: 他谈到听到声音和看到并不存在的人。

sentences.en: In 1999, Juan Alvarez married a woman named Carmelita.
sentences.zh: 1999年，胡安·阿尔瓦雷斯与一个名叫卡梅利塔（Carmelita）的女人结婚。

sentences.en: He raised Carmelita's daughter, and the couple had a son of their own.
sentences.zh: 他抚养了卡梅利塔的女儿，两人还育有一个属于他们自己的儿子。

sentences.en: Juan enjoyed fatherhood and worked construction jobs to support his family, but was never able to shake his
sentences.zh: 胡安享受着为人父的乐趣，靠做建筑工作来养家糊口，但始终无法摆脱他的

sentences.en: methamphetamine habit, even getting higher when looking after his children.
sentences.zh: 冰毒瘾，甚至在照顾孩子时也吸毒过量。

sentences.en: In 2004, Juan badly injured his arm at a work site.
sentences.zh: 2004年，胡安在一个工地上严重弄伤了手臂。

sentences.en: As it never completely healed, he was unable to return to the laborious work he relied on.
sentences.zh: 由于伤势从未完全康复，他无法再从事他所依赖的体力劳动。

sentences.en: He fell into a deep depression as his financial concerns mounted.
sentences.zh: 随着经济压力的增加，他陷入了深深的抑郁之中。

sentences.en: Family members sent Juan money to pay off the bills, but his ongoing unemployment and drug addiction ensured that he was never financially sound.
sentences.zh: 家属给胡安寄钱用来付账单，但他持续失业和吸毒，导致他财务状况从未稳定过。

sentences.en: After two failed attempts at rehabilitation, Juan was kicked out of home by Carmelita, who also filed a restraining order against him to prevent him from seeing his children.
sentences.zh: 在两次戒毒失败后，胡安被卡梅利塔赶出家门，卡梅利塔还对她申请了限制令，禁止他见自己的孩子。

sentences.en: Juan resettled in Glendale.
sentences.zh: 胡安在格伦代尔重新安家。

sentences.en: On Saturday, January 22, 2005, Juan phoned Carmelita, begging to see his children.
sentences.zh: 2005年1月22日星期六，胡安给卡梅利塔打电话，恳求见他的孩子。

sentences.en: Carmelita refused, wanting Juan to deal with his demons firSt.
sentences.zh: 卡梅利塔拒绝了，希望胡安先正视并解决他心中的恶魔。

sentences.en: She did allow him to speak to them over the phone.
sentences.zh: 她确实允许他在电话里和他们说话。

sentences.en: Before ending the call, Juan said to Carmelita,
sentences.zh: 在挂断电话之前，胡安对卡梅利塔说：

sentences.en: Four days later, on Wednesday, January 26, Juan Alvarez woke early.
sentences.zh: 四天后的1月26日星期三，胡安·阿尔瓦雷斯很早就醒了。

sentences.en: Despite his weak hand, he'd secured some work on a construction site.
sentences.zh: 尽管手部无力，他还是在某处建筑工地上找到了一份工作。

sentences.en: He was due at the work site at 7am in Pasadena, eight miles from his home.
sentences.zh: 他本应于上午7点到达位于帕萨迪纳的工地，该地距离他家八英里。

sentences.en: Juan showered and tied his long black hair into a ponytail to keep it off his face.
sentences.zh: 胡安冲了澡，把长长的黑发扎成马尾辫，免得挡住脸。

sentences.en: Before leaving, he watered the roses that bloomed outside his house.
sentences.zh: 离开前，他给屋外的盛开的玫瑰浇了水。

sentences.en: He was happy, life was looking up, and Juan was optimistically waiting on the results of a drug teSt.
sentences.zh: 他很开心，生活正在好转，胡安乐观地等待着药物测试的结果。

sentences.en: The negative result that he expected meant he could see his kids again soon.
sentences.zh: 他所期望的阴性结果意味着他很快就能再见到他的孩子了。

sentences.en: By 5.30am, Juan was on the road in his Jeep with plenty of time to spare.
sentences.zh: 到早上5点30分，胡安开着他的吉普车上路了，时间还很充裕。

sentences.en: He headed towards a gas station to fill up his car.
sentences.zh: 他朝加油站驶去给车加油。

sentences.en: On the way, he heard Carmelita in the back seat telling him over and over how stupid he was.
sentences.zh: 在路上，他听到后座上的卡梅利塔一遍又一遍地告诉他他是多么愚蠢。

sentences.en: She was unrelenting in her taunts.
sentences.zh: 她的嘲讽毫不留情。

sentences.en: Juan snapped.
sentences.zh: 胡安崩溃了。

sentences.en: He filled his tank with gasoline as well as two one-gallon plastic jugs.
sentences.zh: 他给油箱加满汽油，还加了两个一加仑的塑料壶。

sentences.en: He had made his decision.
sentences.zh: 他已经做出了决定。

sentences.en: Juan was going to set his car on fire with himself inside.
sentences.zh: 胡安打算连人带车一起烧掉。

sentences.en: Juan drove around looking for a dark and deserted place.
sentences.zh: 胡安开车到处寻找一个黑暗荒凉的地方。

sentences.en: Carmelita continued to berate him from the back seat, now joined by a man whom Juan presumed to be her lover.
sentences.zh: 卡梅利塔继续在后座上斥责他，现在还加入了一个胡安认为可能是她情夫的男人。

sentences.en: He stopped briefly at Chevy Chase Park.
sentences.zh: 他在雪佛龙蔡斯公园（Chevy Chase Park）短暂地停了一下。

sentences.en: The park fit his specifications, it was quiet and unlit, with the sun not due to rise for another 90 minutes.
sentences.zh: 这个公园符合他的要求，安静且没有灯光，距离太阳升起还有一个半小时。

sentences.en: Yet, Juan was not satisfied and continued along Chevy Chase Drive, then turned into a side street, where he parked directly under a streetlight.
sentences.zh: 然而，胡安并不满意，继续沿着雪莉蔡斯大道前行，接着拐入一条小路，将车直接停在路灯下方。

sentences.en: He emptied one gallon of gasoline over his head and body.
sentences.zh: 他把整整一加仑的汽油倒在自己的头部和身上。

sentences.en: He poured the rest all over the exterior and interior of his car.
sentences.zh: 其余的汽油则全被他倒在了汽车的外壳和车内。

sentences.en: With all the windows and doors closed, Juan sat back into the driver's seat.
sentences.zh: 在所有车窗和车门都紧闭的情况下，胡安重新坐回了驾驶座。

sentences.en: He felt dizzy and nauseous from the fumes.
sentences.zh: 浓烈的气味让他感到头晕目眩、恶心想吐。

sentences.en: Hands shaking, he held up a lighter.
sentences.zh: 他双手颤抖着，举起了一个打火机。

sentences.en: Again, Juan changed his mind.
sentences.zh: 但胡安再次改变了主意。

sentences.en: Burning alive would be a terrible way to die.
sentences.zh: 被活活烧死将是一种极其痛苦的死法。

sentences.en: He drove back up to Chevy Chase Drive and then, at the railway crossing, entered the restricted area of the tracks and drove parallel to the railroad line for about 50 yards.
sentences.zh: 他开车返回雪莉蔡斯大道，随后在铁道路口驶入轨道管制区，沿着铁路线平行行驶了大约50码。

sentences.en: Juan then parked his car over the tracks.
sentences.zh: 接着，胡安将车停在了铁轨正上方。

sentences.en: Over the next 15 minutes, he looked at photographs of his two children and came to the realisation that he was making a huge mistake.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的15分钟里，他看着两个孩子的照片，终于意识到自己正在犯下一个大错。

sentences.en: He tried backing up his Jeep, but it wouldn't budge.
sentences.zh: 他试图倒回他的吉普车，但车子纹丝不动。

sentences.en: It was stuck on the track.
sentences.zh: 它被卡在铁轨上了。

sentences.en: Juan climbed out of his car and attempted to push it off, but to no avail.
sentences.zh: 胡安爬出车外，试图把车推开，但徒劳无功。

sentences.en: He placed a large rock under a rear wheel to leverage the vehicle upwards and forwards.
sentences.zh: 他在一个后轮下面放了一块大石头，想借此把车身向上、向前撬动。

sentences.en: Pressing his foot to the gas pedal, the wheel spun in place and the car didn't budge.
sentences.zh: 他踩下油门，车轮在原地空转，汽车依然纹丝不动。

sentences.en: As he sat defeated in the front seat, Juan heard the sound of a blaring horn approaching.
sentences.zh: 正当他沮丧地坐在前排时，胡安听到了一声刺耳逼近的鸣笛声。

sentences.en: At 5.59am, Edward Branch was waiting in his car.
sentences.zh: 早上5点59分，爱德华·布兰奇正坐在车里等待。

sentences.en: The barrier along the Chevy Chase Drive level crossing had just lowered in anticipation of a passing train.
sentences.zh: 雪莉蔡斯大道平交道口的栏杆刚刚放下，正准备迎接一列即将通过的列车。

sentences.en: As Edward waited, he noticed a Jeep on the tracks nearby.
sentences.zh: 在等待时，爱德华注意到附近铁轨上停着一辆吉普车。

sentences.en: A double-decker train was barrelling towards it.
sentences.zh: 一辆双层列车正疾驰着撞向它。

sentences.en: It made contact with the car, resulting in a fiery crash.
sentences.zh: 列车撞上了汽车，引发了一场惨烈的火灾。

sentences.en: Moments later, a second train travelling in the opposite direction smashed into the carnage.
sentences.zh: 片刻之后，另一列从相反方向驶来的列车轰然撞入了这片废墟。

sentences.en: A man suddenly appeared from the side of the tracks, near where the Jeep had been parked.
sentences.zh: 一个男人突然从铁轨旁出现，就在吉普车原本停放的地方附近。

sentences.en: He then headed towards the destruction.
sentences.zh: 随后，他朝着这片毁灭的现场走去。

sentences.en: Juan Alvarez ran to the wreckage and approached a passenger who'd escaped MetroLink 100 with only minor injuries.
sentences.zh: 胡安·阿尔瓦雷斯跑向残骸，靠近了一名从100号城铁逃生、仅受轻伤的乘客。

sentences.en: Juan asked him what had happened.
sentences.zh: 胡安问他发生了什么事。

sentences.en: He was told that the train had crashed and people had died.
sentences.zh: 对方告诉他，火车相撞了，有人死亡。

sentences.en: Juan exclaimed,
sentences.zh: 胡安惊呼道：

sentences.en: Oh no!
sentences.zh: 天哪！

sentences.en: And fell to the ground.
sentences.zh: 然后瘫倒在地。

sentences.en: He was asked if he had anything to do with the collision.
sentences.zh: 有人问他是否与这起碰撞事故有关。

sentences.en: Juan gave no response.
sentences.zh: 胡安没有回答。

sentences.en: Instead, he got up and moved onwards.
sentences.zh: 相反，他站起身继续往前走去。

sentences.en: As he walked amongst the injured and dying, Juan held on to a large eagle feather that he carried with him everywhere.
sentences.zh: 在伤员和垂死者中穿行时，胡安紧紧抓着一根他走到哪带到哪的大鹰羽毛。

sentences.en: He believed that the eagle was an honoured animal that guided the souls of the dead to God.
sentences.zh: 他坚信鹰是受人尊崇的动物，能够引领死者的灵魂去见上帝。

sentences.en: By having the feather with him at that moment, Juan felt he was assisting the dying passengers to enter heaven.
sentences.zh: 那一刻手里握着这根羽毛，让胡安觉得自己在协助濒死的乘客进入天堂。

sentences.en: Raimunda Barsana was going about her typical morning in Glendale when, at 6.15am, Juan Alvarez entered her home.
sentences.zh: 雷蒙达·巴尔萨娜正在格伦代尔经历她平常的早晨，这时在早上6点15分，胡安·阿尔瓦雷斯闯入了她的家。

sentences.en: Raimunda was Juan's landlady and the pair had a good relationship.
sentences.zh: 雷蒙达是胡安的房东，两人关系不错。

sentences.en: In lieu of paying monetary rent, Juan worked as a maintenance man for Raimunda.
sentences.zh: 胡安不付现金房租，而是为雷蒙达做杂工来抵房租。

sentences.en: That day, Raimunda was disturbed to find Juan in her home with his arms and chest covered in blood.
sentences.zh: 那天，雷蒙达惊讶地发现胡安在她家里，他的胳膊和胸口都沾满了血。

sentences.en: Clutched tightly in his hand was a pair of bloodied scissors.
sentences.zh: 他的手里紧紧攥着一把沾血的剪刀。

sentences.en: Juan took Raimunda's phone.
sentences.zh: 胡安拿走了雷蒙达的电话。

sentences.en: He phoned his wife, speaking in a garbled mixture of Spanish and English.
sentences.zh: 他打电话给妻子，用西班牙语和英语夹杂不清的话语说着。

sentences.en: He then called a cousin who had supported him throughout his time in LA.
sentences.zh: 接着，他给一个在他洛杉矶期间一直支持他的表弟打了电话。

sentences.en: He left him a voicemail.
sentences.zh: 他给对方留了一段语音。

sentences.en: I didn't mean this.
sentences.zh: 我不是故意的。

sentences.en: A lot of innocent people died.
sentences.zh: 很多无辜的人死了。

sentences.en: I don't deserve to live.
sentences.zh: 我不配活下去。

sentences.en: I apologise for everything.
sentences.zh: 我为一切道歉。

sentences.en: Please pray for me.
sentences.zh: 请为我祈祷。

sentences.en: Please.
sentences.zh: 求求你们。

sentences.en: As he made the calls, Juan stabbed himself in the chest with the scissors.
sentences.zh: 在打这些电话的同时，胡安用剪刀刺向自己的胸口。

sentences.en: Raimunda contacted 911.
sentences.zh: 雷蒙达拨打了911。

sentences.en: Juan told first responders that he had, quote,
sentences.zh: 胡安对急救人员说，原话是：

sentences.en: Hurt those people.
sentences.zh: 我伤害了那些人。

sentences.en: I jumped in front of the train.
sentences.zh: 我跳到了火车前面。

sentences.en: Officers arrived at the hospital while Juan Alvarez was undergoing treatment for his self-inflicted, non-life-threatening stab wounds.
sentences.zh: 警察赶到医院时，胡安·阿尔瓦雷斯正在接受自己造成的、不危及生命的刺伤治疗。

sentences.en: Juan asked how the people on the trains were before explaining what he had done.
sentences.zh: 胡安先是询问了列车上人们的情况，然后才解释了自己所做的事。

sentences.en: He added,
sentences.zh: 他接着说道：

sentences.en: Juan was arrested and held in custody.
sentences.zh: 胡安被捕并被拘留。

sentences.en: Described as distraught and remorseful, but cooperative, he was charged with one count of arson,
sentences.zh: 他被形容为心神交瘁、悔恨交加，但十分配合，他被控一项纵火罪，

sentences.en: one count of train wrecking with intent to cause derailment, and 11 counts of first-degree murder with special circumstances.
sentences.zh: 一项蓄意导致列车脱轨的毁坏列车罪，以及十一项伴有特殊情节的谋杀罪。

sentences.en: The special circumstances arose due to their being multiple victims, and so, if found guilty, Juan faced the death penalty.
sentences.zh: 由于有多名受害者，因此存在特殊情节，如果罪名成立，胡安将面临死刑。

sentences.en: Carmelita visited her husband while he was in custody.
sentences.zh: 卡梅莉塔在胡安被拘留期间探望了他。

sentences.en: She told the Washington Post about the moment he decided not to end his own life.
sentences.zh: 她向《华盛顿邮报》讲述了他决定放弃轻生那一刻的情形。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 原话是：

sentences.en: He said he felt like there was a presence from God, telling him to get away.
sentences.zh: 他说他感觉到有一种神圣的存在，在告诉他离开。

sentences.en: The restraining order that Carmelita had previously placed on Juan was also in part to his mental state.
sentences.zh: 卡梅莉塔此前对胡安申请限制令，部分原因也是出于他的精神状态。

sentences.en: His behaviour had increasingly become erratic and threatening lately.
sentences.zh: 他的行为近来变得越来越反复无常、充满威胁。

sentences.en: He exhibited paranoia and obsessive jealousy and accused her of cheating on him with his cousin, neighbours, co-workers, and strangers.
sentences.zh: 他表现出偏执和强迫性的嫉妒，指责她与他的表弟、邻居、同事以及陌生人有染。

sentences.en: He suspected Carmelita recorded him with hidden cameras in his bedroom.
sentences.zh: 他怀疑卡梅莉塔在他的卧室里用隐藏摄像头偷拍他。

sentences.en: He also believed she was making pornography videos with other people.
sentences.zh: 他还坚信她一直在和别人制作色情视频。

sentences.en: Juan purchased a firearm and repeatedly threatened Carmelita's lovers, all of whom were figments of his imagination.
sentences.zh: 胡安买了一把枪，并多次威胁卡梅莉塔的情夫们，而这些人全都是他凭空想象出来的。

sentences.en: He even considered killing Carmelita.
sentences.zh: 他甚至考虑过杀死卡梅莉塔。

sentences.en: Juan was opposed to seeking psychiatric help, so Carmelita sought a restraining order to protect herself and their children.
sentences.zh: 胡安反对寻求精神科治疗，因此卡梅莉塔申请了限制令来保护自己和他们的孩子。

sentences.en: This caused Juan's lifelong suicidal inclination to re-emerge.
sentences.zh: 这导致胡安终生的自杀倾向再次死灰复燃。

sentences.en: He had told others of his intentions to end his life.
sentences.zh: 他曾向其他人透露过自己想要结束生命的打算。

sentences.en: In preparation for the trial, Juan Alvarez was interviewed by a number of psychiatrists.
sentences.zh: 为了准备审判，胡安·阿尔瓦雷斯接受了多位精神病学专家的面谈。

sentences.en: Juan diagnosed him with a psychotic mood disorder and attributed Juan's impulsive behaviour and irritability to this disorder.
sentences.zh: 其中一位精神科医生诊断他患有精神病性心境障碍，并将胡安冲动的行为和易怒归咎于这种障碍。

sentences.en: Another psychiatrist was of the opinion that Juan showed logical, goal-oriented behaviour on the day of the train crash.
sentences.zh: 另一位精神科医生则认为，在列车相撞当天，胡安表现出了合乎逻辑、有目的性的行为。

sentences.en: Others theorised that Juan's desire to end his own life was the result of a depressing come-down off a methamphetamine high, which he admitted to using prior to the train crash.
sentences.zh: 还有人推测，胡安结束自己生命的渴望，是在吸食冰毒（他承认在撞车前曾使用过）后产生情绪低落的后果。

sentences.en: On the morning of the train crash, Juan recalled Carmelita belittling him from the back seat of his jeep as he drove around searching for the ideal place to take his life.
sentences.zh: 在列车相撞的早晨，胡安回忆起当他开车四处寻找自杀的理想地点时，卡梅莉塔在吉普车后座上贬低他。

sentences.en: At one point, she was joined by a man Juan identified as one of her lovers.
sentences.zh: 有一会儿，一个被胡安认作是她情夫的男人也加入了她的行列。

sentences.en: However, there were no others in the vehicle at the time.
sentences.zh: 然而当时车里并没有其他人。

sentences.en: They were delusions.
sentences.zh: 这些都是他的幻觉。

sentences.en: During this bickering, Juan contemplated visiting Carmelita at work and killing her, but it was too early for her to be there.
sentences.zh: 在这场争吵中，胡安曾考虑过去卡梅莉塔的工作地点杀了她，但当时去还为时过早。

sentences.en: Even though Juan knew that Carmelita couldn't be in two places at once, he was still convinced she was sitting behind him with another man.
sentences.zh: 尽管胡安明知卡梅莉塔不可能分身在两个地方，但他仍然坚信她正带着另一个男人坐在他身后。

sentences.en: He heard the pair remarking,
sentences.zh: 他听到两人评头论足道：

sentences.en: Look at how stupid he is.
sentences.zh: 看他有多蠢。

sentences.en: He can't even see us.
sentences.zh: 他连我们都看不到。

sentences.en: Their words angered Juan and his attention turned to the railway tracks.
sentences.zh: 他们的话惹怒了胡安，他的注意力转移到了铁轨上。

sentences.en: He believed if he took his life there, it would get Carmelita's attention and make her feel bad.
sentences.zh: 他坚信如果自己在那里结束生命，就能引起卡梅莉塔的注意，并让她感到内疚。

sentences.en: Juan maintained that he didn't realise a passenger train would approach.
sentences.zh: 胡安坚称自己并没有意识到会有客运列车开来。

sentences.en: He expected a cargo train that would smash through his car and continue along without derailing.
sentences.zh: 他原本预计来的是一列货运火车，会直接撞穿他的汽车然后继续行驶而不会脱轨。

sentences.en: He claimed he wasn't thinking about the consequences of his actions, including that others could be harmed or killed by his plan.
sentences.zh: 他声称自己当时根本没有考虑自己行为的后果，包括他的计划可能会伤害或杀死其他人。

sentences.en: He knew of an instance wherein a train collided with a taxi.
sentences.zh: 他知道曾发生过火车与出租车相撞的案例。

sentences.en: The taxi's occupants were killed, but no one on the train was harmed.
sentences.zh: 出租车上的人遇难了，但火车上无一人受伤。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 罪案实录稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商广告以支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也是在支持罪案实录继续为您提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Juan Alvarez's trial began in late April 2008.
sentences.zh: 胡安·阿尔瓦雷斯的审判于2008年4月下旬开始。

sentences.en: His defence team insisted that Juan never intended for anyone to be hurt by his actions.
sentences.zh: 他的辩护团队坚称，胡安从头到尾都没想过要让任何人因他的行为而受伤。

sentences.en: He wanted to take his own life, but changed his mind at the last moment.
sentences.zh: 他只是想结束自己的生命，但在最后一刻改变了主意。

sentences.en: This desire had lingered since childhood, prompted by physical and sexual abuse, drug dependency, untreated mental health issues, and a failing marriage.
sentences.zh: 这种求死之心自童年起就一直挥之不去，这是由身体和性虐待、药物依赖、未得到治疗的心理健康问题以及一段频频告急的婚姻所引发的。

sentences.en: Juan offered the families of his victims an apology in court, maintaining that he never intended to hurt their loved ones.
sentences.zh: 胡安在法庭上向受害者家属道歉，并坚称他从未打算伤害他们所爱的人。

sentences.en: In contrast, the prosecution argued that Juan Alvarez had no intention of taking his own life.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，控方则辩称胡安·阿尔瓦雷斯根本没有自杀的打算。

sentences.en: Rather, he wanted to create a grand spectacle
sentences.zh: 相反，他是想制造一场轰动的场面。

sentences.en: There were elements about Juan's story that didn't add up to evidence at the scene.
sentences.zh: 胡安供述中的一些细节与现场证据并不相符。

sentences.en: Juan claimed that he had poured gasoline on himself and his vehicle, with the initial intention to set himself alight.
sentences.zh: 胡安声称他把汽油倒在了自己和车上，最初的意图是自焚。

sentences.en: His clothing from that day tested positive for traces of gasoline, but an amount that arson investigators attributed to splashback when pouring it all over his vehicle,
sentences.zh: 他当天的衣物经检测呈汽油阳性，但纵火调查人员认为，这个量是在把汽油倒满汽车时飞溅上去的，

sentences.en: not directly over himself.
sentences.zh: 而不是直接倒在自己身上的。

sentences.en: Witnesses who had interacted with Juan immediately after the crash noted that he didn't smell of gasoline.
sentences.zh: 在车祸发生后立即与胡安接触过的目击者指出，他身上并没有汽油味。

sentences.en: Doctors who had treated him didn't recall Juan's eyes or skin as being red, inflamed, or irritated.
sentences.zh: 为他治疗的医生并不记得胡安的眼睛或皮肤有发红、红肿或刺激的症状。

sentences.en: Telltale signs of prolonged exposure to gasoline.
sentences.zh: 这是长期接触汽油的明显迹象。

sentences.en: The prosecution insisted that Juan didn't make the bona fide attempt to take his own life, as he alleged.
sentences.zh: 控方坚称，胡安并没有像他所声称的那样进行真正的自杀尝试。

sentences.en: Furthermore, an expert witness revealed that fire damage on the jeep's parking brake assembly indicated that it was activated at the time of impact.
sentences.zh: 此外，一位专家证人透露，吉普车驻车制动总成上的火灾损毁痕迹表明，它在撞击时处于激活状态。

sentences.en: This meant the car was in park, which contradicted Juan's claims that he had made considerable effort to try and move the jeep to avoid a collision.
sentences.zh: 这意味着当时汽车挂着泊车挡，这与胡安声称他曾付出巨大努力试图挪开吉普车以避免碰撞的说法相矛盾。

sentences.en: Witnesses reported that only the car's passenger door was open at the time it was demolished,
sentences.zh: 目击者报告称，在汽车被撞毁时，只有副驾驶车门是开着的，

sentences.en: which contradicted Juan's claims that he had thrown himself from the driver's side seconds before impact.
sentences.zh: 这与胡安声称他在撞击前几秒钟从驾驶座一侧跳车的说法相矛盾。

sentences.en: Additionally, the vehicle's headlights were off, indicating Juan didn't intend for it to be seen until it was too late.
sentences.zh: 此外，车头大灯是熄灭的，这表明胡安并不打算让车子在为时已晚之前被人发现。

sentences.en: There was no debate that the gasoline Juan had poured over his jeep was a contributing factor in starting the blaze that consumed MetroLink 100's front passenger carriage.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，胡安泼在吉普车上的汽油是引发大火的一个因素，正是这场大火吞噬了100号城铁的前排客运车厢。

sentences.en: The arson count was crucial to Juan's case.
sentences.zh: 纵火罪名对胡安的案件至关重要。

sentences.en: The felony statute on arson in California meant that if Juan was found guilty of causing the fire,
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚州的纵火重罪法规定，如果胡安被判犯有纵火导致火灾的罪行，

sentences.en: he was to be held liable for the murders, even if he didn't intend to kill anyone.
sentences.zh: 那么即使他无意杀人，他也必须对这些谋杀承担法律责任。

sentences.en: Even the defence's expert witness agreed with most of the prosecution's findings.
sentences.zh: 就连辩方的专家证人也同意控方的大多数调查结果。

sentences.en: They conceded that if a person poured gasoline over their vehicle and waited for a train to collide with it,
sentences.zh: 他们承认，如果一个人把汽油倒在车上并等待火车与之相撞，

sentences.en: then they probably intended for a fire to start, using the train as an ignition source.
sentences.zh: 那么他们很可能是想利用火车作为火源来引发一场火灾。

sentences.en: After three hours of deliberation, the jury found Juan Alvarez guilty of one count of arson and of all eleven counts of first-degree murder with special circumstances.
sentences.zh: 经过三个小时的审议，陪审团裁定胡安·阿尔瓦雷斯一项纵火罪名成立，以及十一项伴有特殊情节的一级谋杀罪名全部成立。

sentences.en: They found him not guilty of train wrecking, unsatisfied that he intended to derail the train.
sentences.zh: 他们裁定他的毁坏列车罪不成立，因为没有确凿证据表明他意图让火车脱轨。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, the guilty verdict ensured Juan would face a possible death sentence.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，有罪裁决确保了胡安将面临被判处死刑的可能。

sentences.en: In talking to the Daily News, three members of the jury said they likely would not have convicted Juan
sentences.zh: 在接受《每日新闻》采访时，三名陪审团成员表示，要不是因为纵火重罪法，他们可能不会将胡安

sentences.en: Alvarez of murder had it not been for the felony statute on arson.
sentences.zh: 阿尔瓦雷斯定为谋杀罪。

sentences.en: The jury foreman said,
sentences.zh: 陪审团长说道：

sentences.en: The week prior to the verdict, the jury inspected four of the train cars damaged in the collision.
sentences.zh: 在作出裁决的前一周，陪审团检查了四节在碰撞中损毁的列车车厢。

sentences.en: Rather than implicate Juan Alvarez, the wreckage had the opposite effect.
sentences.zh: 这些残骸非但没有给胡安·阿尔瓦雷斯定罪，反而产生了相反的效果。

sentences.en: The jury foreman told the Daily News that seeing the wreckage reaffirmed his belief that Juan did not expect anyone to get injured, quote,
sentences.zh: 陪审团长告诉《每日新闻》，看到残骸后，他更加确信胡安根本没料到会有人受伤，原话是：

sentences.en: Seeing how big those trains were and how heavy they were, I really don't think a reasonable person would expect a train to derail by parking their car on the tracks.
sentences.zh: 看到那些火车是多么庞大、多么沉重，我真的不认为一个理智的人会指望把车停在铁轨上就能让火车脱轨。

sentences.en: In the weeks following the trial, the jury opted to remove the death penalty as a possible sentence, reasoning that Juan Alvarez never intended to kill.
sentences.zh: 在审判结束后的几周里，陪审团选择取消死刑作为可能的量刑，理由是胡安·阿尔瓦雷斯从未有过杀人的企图。

sentences.en: Juan's wife and cousin were featured in the LA Times pleading for leniency, citing that he belonged in a mental institution, not on death row.
sentences.zh: 胡安的妻子和表弟在《洛杉矶时报》上露面，呼吁法庭宽大处理，并声称他应该待在精神病院里，而不是死囚牢房里。

sentences.en: They regretted not getting Juan the psychiatric help he needed, saying they believed the catastrophe could have been avoided if they had.
sentences.zh: 他们后悔没有为胡安寻求他需要的精神科帮助，并表示他们相信如果做了，这场灾难本可以避免。

sentences.en: The Superior Court judge was far more sceptical of Juan Alvarez.
sentences.zh: 高等法院法官对胡安·阿尔瓦雷斯的态度要怀疑得多。

sentences.en: He didn't believe that Juan was unaware that his actions would have dire consequences for others.
sentences.zh: 他不相信胡安会不知道自己的行为会给他人带来可怕的后果。

sentences.en: He told Alvarez that the phone message he left for his cousin following the crash seemed set up, like somebody playing a part, and that it sounded…
sentences.zh: 他告诉阿尔瓦雷斯，他在车祸后给他表弟留下的电话留言听起来像是事先安排好的，就像某个在演戏的人，而且听起来……

sentences.en: Like a very bad actor trying to convince the person that he really feels as he says he does, and it doesn't ring true.
sentences.zh: 就像一个演技非常糟糕的演员，试图说服别人他确实有着他所说的感受，这听起来很不真实。

sentences.en: The judge told Juan,
sentences.zh: 法官对胡安说：

sentences.en: I don't believe for a minute you intended to kill yourself or harm yourself in any way.
sentences.zh: 我一分钟都不会相信你曾打算自杀或以任何方式伤害自己。

sentences.en: I think you were setting up a scenario so you could go back to your family.
sentences.zh: 我认为你是在精心策划一个场景，好让你能回到家人身边。

sentences.en: If there was a sentence known as forever in state prison, I would give it to you.
sentences.zh: 如果在州监狱里有一种刑罚叫作终身监禁，我会把它判给你。

sentences.en: What I'm going to do is almost the equivalent.
sentences.zh: 而我将要做的事几乎和这个等价。

sentences.en: And I agree that these 11 people who died and their families deserve a maximum sentence in this case.
sentences.zh: 我同意这11名遇难者以及他们的家属在本案中应当获得最高刑罚。

sentences.en: Juan was given 11 consecutive life sentences.
sentences.zh: 胡安被判处11个连续的终身监禁。

sentences.en: It was the maximum sentence that could be awarded given that the death penalty had been taken off the table.
sentences.zh: 鉴于死刑已被排除适用，这是当时能够判处的最高刑罚。

sentences.en: Juan Alvarez appealed his conviction in 2012, arguing, in part, that the prosecution failed to prove a connection between the arson he committed and the deaths of the victiMs.
sentences.zh: 胡安·阿尔瓦雷斯在2012年对他的定罪提起了上诉，部分理由是控方未能证明他所实施的纵火与受害者的死亡之间存在因果关系。

sentences.en: His appeal failed.
sentences.zh: 他的上诉失败了。

sentences.en: A number of the survivors of the Glendale train crash filed a civil lawsuit against MetroLink,
sentences.zh: 格伦代尔火车相撞事故的多名幸存者对美铁（MetroLink）提起了民事诉讼，

sentences.en: claiming that the tragedy could have been avoided had the engineer of MetroLink 100, Bruce Gray, followed protocol.
sentences.zh: 声称如果“美铁100”号列车的司机布鲁斯·格雷遵守了规程，这场悲剧本可以避免。

sentences.en: During the trial, Bruce testified that in the seconds before the crash, he saw what appeared to be a reflection coming from a vehicle about three quarters of a mile ahead.
sentences.zh: 在审判期间，布鲁斯作证说，在撞车前的几秒钟里，他看到前方约四分之三英里处的一辆汽车似乎传来了反光。

sentences.en: Bruce said he became fixated on the area, and when he saw an outline of the jeep, he hit the train's emergency brakes.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯说他的注意力被那个区域吸引住了，当他看到吉普车的轮廓时，他紧急踩下了列车的刹车。

sentences.en: However, the black box taken from the train wreckage revealed that the service brakes had only been applied initially,
sentences.zh: 然而，从列车残骸中取出的黑匣子显示，最初只踩了工作制动器，

sentences.en: with a few critical seconds passing before the emergency brakes were activated.
sentences.zh: 在启动紧急制动之前，经历了至关重要的几秒钟。

sentences.en: The attorney representing the victims argued that had Bruce Gray applied the brakes when he said he had a trial, the crash could have been avoided.
sentences.zh: 代表受害者的律师辩称，如果布鲁斯·格雷像他所说的那样及时踩下刹车，这场撞车事故本可以避免。

sentences.en: MetroLink settled the lawsuit with a $39 million combined payout.
sentences.zh: 美铁最终以总计3900万美元的赔偿金与这起诉讼达成和解。

sentences.en: Following the Glendale train crash, MetroLink's fleet underwent changes, with a spokesman claiming that it was now the safest commuter rail line in the country.
sentences.zh: 格伦代尔火车相撞事故发生后，美铁的车队进行了改造，一位发言人声称它现在是全国最安全的通勤铁路线。

sentences.en: Their trains were fitted out with crash energy management technology that included bumpers designed to absorb the lion's share of energy from a collision.
sentences.zh: 他们的列车配备了碰撞能量管理技术，其中包括旨在吸收碰撞时绝大部分能量的保险杠。

sentences.en: Eleven unrelated fates were sealed when Juan Alvarez abandoned his jeep on the Ventura line near Glendale train station on January 26, 2005.
sentences.zh: 2005年1月26日，当胡安·阿尔瓦雷斯将他的吉普车遗弃在格伦代尔火车站附近的文图拉铁路线时，11个互不相干的命运就此注定。

sentences.en: Manuel Alcala aged 51, Julia Bennett aged 44,
sentences.zh: 现年51岁的曼努埃尔·阿尔卡拉、现年44岁的朱莉娅·贝内特，

sentences.en: Alfonso Caballero aged 62, Elizabeth Hill aged 65, Scott McCown aged 42, William Perrin aged 53,
sentences.zh: 现年62岁的阿方索·卡巴列罗、现年65岁的伊丽莎白·希尔、现年42岁的斯科特·麦考恩、现年53岁的威廉·佩林，

sentences.en: James Titino aged 47, and Don Wiley aged 58, lost their lives aboard MetroLink 100.
sentences.zh: 现年47岁的詹姆斯·蒂蒂诺以及现年58岁的唐·威利，在“美铁100”号列车上失去了生命。

sentences.en: Leonard Romero aged 53, Henry Kalinsky aged 39, and the train's engineer, Thomas Ormiston aged 58, died on MetroLink 901.
sentences.zh: 现年53岁的伦纳德·罗梅罗、现年39岁的亨利·卡林斯基，以及列车司机、现年58岁的托马斯·奥尔米斯顿，在“美铁901”号列车上丧生。

sentences.en: Thomas had worked on trains since 1972.
sentences.zh: 托马斯自1972年以来一直从事铁路工作。

sentences.en: His job was often a topic of conversation whenever he dropped his car off to his mechanic and friend,
sentences.zh: 每当他把车送到他的机械师兼朋友那里时，他的工作往往成了谈话的主题，

sentences.en: Walter.
sentences.zh: 这个朋友叫沃尔特。

sentences.en: During one visit, the pair spoke of the possibility of a train crash occurring after reading about similar incidents in the papers.
sentences.zh: 在一次拜访中，两人在报纸上读到类似事件后，谈到了发生火车相撞事故的可能性。

sentences.en: Walter asked Thomas if he was worried about such things.
sentences.zh: 沃尔特问托马斯是否担心这种事情。

sentences.en: No, it's okay, Thomas responded.
sentences.zh: “没事，没关系，”托马斯回答说。

sentences.en: Accidents will happen.
sentences.zh: “意外总是会发生的。”

sentences.en: You can hear what's going on.
sentences.zh: 你能听到正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: You have thesem justice.
sentences.zh: 你拥有这些正义。

sentences.en: He watched the sending request and known for other activities,
sentences.zh: 他看着发送请求并以其他活动闻名，
